svg.title: A hyperbolic jet lift and an odd flat normal-plane vacuum
svg.desc: The invariant vertical frame is X equals partial r plus t partial t, Y equals partial t. In b equals exp minus r times t and v equals exp minus r, the fiber metric is the upper half-plane metric. A compact cycle has a smooth equivariant lift, and its character is pushed along a Borel section. A separately specified flat Pauli oscillator has ground energies zero, two, two and four; its unique zero state is odd. The lifted cycle's measure trace equals its Godbillon-Vey character evaluation. The actual ordered Thom operator and proper-cycle comparison are proved separately in Propositions 13.6 and 13.7 and drawn in Figure 13.2.
svg.metadata: Original CC0 diagram. Lemma 13.1, Proposition 13.2, Lemma 13.3 and equation 13.7. Human source: Connes, transverse fundamental class, Lemma 7.8.
